Theorem
[Higher interior regularity] ↗ thm:interior-h2-regularity 1. ch6:6.3-thm-2\group Regularity Theory

Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, and assume \[ (25) \qquad a^{ij}, b^i, c \in C^{m+1}(U) \quad (i,j=1,\ldots ,n) \] and \[ (26) \qquad f \in H^m(U). \] Suppose $u \in H^1(U)$ is a weak solution of the elliptic PDE \[ Lu = f \quad \text{in } U. \] Then \[ (27) \qquad u \in H^{m+2}_{\text{loc}}(U); \] and for each $V \subset \subset U$ we have the estimate \[ (28) \qquad \| u\| _{H^{m+2}(V)} \leq C(\| f\| _{H^m(U)} + \| u\| _{L^2(U)}), \] the constant $C$ depending only on $m, U, V$ and the coefficients of $L$.

Proof

\sketch Induct on $m$. Differentiate the equation weakly, regard each first derivative of $u$ as solving an elliptic equation whose right-hand side is controlled by the induction hypothesis, apply interior $H^2$ regularity on nested domains, and sum the resulting estimates.

□
